title: size doesn't matter, tinyhouse chess is actually fun
summary: Tinyhouse on chess.com: 4x4 crazyhouse with weak pieces - the Ferz (moves like an X, one diagonal step), the Dragon Knight (a knight that can't jump: one orthogonal step then one diagonal step) and the Wazir 'Bob' (one orthogonal step, 'moves like a plus'). Goal: reach the leaderboard (>=1830); starts 1620 in bullet, ends at 1710.
rules: 4x4 board. Each side: King, Wazir ('Bob', 1 step orthogonally), Dragon Knight (non-leaping knight: 1 orthogonal then 1 diagonal outward, blocked if the orthogonal square is occupied), Ferz (1 step diagonally), and one pawn.
Crazyhouse drops: captured pieces go to your pocket and may be dropped on any empty square.
Pawn promotes on the last rank to a Ferz, Wazir or Dragon Knight (no queen).
Normal check/checkmate; stalemate is a draw.
